zh.title: 角色与权限配置总览
zh.summary: 系统配置页面包含角色权限、成员账号、操作日志三个页签；定义每个角色可访问的功能模块及操作级别，并为成员账号分配角色与数据权限（业务线）范围。

zh.title: 线索分配与掉库规则配置
zh.summary: 在销售中心右上角「分配与掉库设置」中，按业务线配置掉库规则与销售线索分配比例。

zh.title: 数据权限与客户敏感信息保护
zh.summary: 配置谁能看到客户手机号、通话录音与导出权限，满足三国数据合规要求。（骨架篇，待补充）

zh.title: 触达通道与外显号码配置
zh.summary: 管理各国外呼外显方案、IM 通道（Zalo/LINE/WhatsApp）账号与模板申请。（骨架篇，待补充）

zh.title: 查询系统配置操作日志
zh.summary: 在系统配置 → 操作日志页签，按模块、操作人、时间范围追溯谁在什么时间改了什么配置。

zh.title: 管理成员账号与绑定外呼
zh.summary: 在系统配置 → 成员账号页签新增/编辑成员、分配角色与业务线、启用停用账号，并为坐席绑定外呼。

zh.title: 查看管理看板与转化漏斗
zh.summary: 按业务线查看同一注册批次的六环转化漏斗、销售跟进与支付结果。

zh.title: 营销中心配置总览
zh.summary: 营销中心五步配置链路：渠道 → SKU → 渠道 SKU 关联 → 落地页 → 皮肤，支撑投放归因与售卖。

zh.title: 新增与维护渠道
zh.summary: 先维护业务线下的渠道类型，再建立具体的销售、KOL、Meta、Google 等渠道；渠道码由系统生成。

zh.title: 查询可售 SKU
zh.summary: SKU 由商品系统统一维护；营销中心仅用于查询和选择已有商品。

zh.title: 配置渠道 SKU 关联与售卖价格
zh.summary: 每个渠道仅维护一套关联规则；在同一行查看每个 SKU 的售卖规则与应付金额，可配置折扣或立减。

zh.title: 创建落地页与获取投放链接
zh.summary: 先选择页面类型：获客落地页仅关联渠道；支付落地页再关联 SKU，并可选择是否使用优惠。

zh.title: 配置落地页皮肤
zh.summary: 按业务线配置落地页皮肤；提交后才发布并生成模板 ID，供落地页管理选择。

zh.title: 查询订单与导出订单列表
zh.summary: 在订单中心按订单ID/用户/商品/优惠码查询订单，核对订单状态与支付方式，支持导出。

zh.title: 销售中心总览与线索流转规则
zh.summary: 销售中心包含公海、我的跟进、已付费、通话记录四个页签；线索流转遵循固定流程，另有组长专属的分配与掉库设置。

zh.title: 如何领取一条新线索
zh.summary: 从销售中心「公海」页签领取待跟进线索。

zh.title: 如何外呼并留下通话小结
zh.summary: 在销售中心点击「拨号」发起外呼，挂断后补全通话小结并保存；首次使用需完成电话条设置。

zh.title: 如何记录一次跟进
zh.summary: 在「我的跟进」通过行内「更多 → 更新跟进」，把客户反馈、下一步动作和回访时间留在 CRM。

zh.title: 如何转分配或退回公海
zh.summary: 销售组长可在「我的跟进」通过「更多 → 重新分配线索」交接线索；退回公海需填写原因。

zh.title: 如何查看通话记录与录音
zh.summary: 在销售中心「通话记录」页签按客户或通话结果回看外呼记录，可播放录音、下载文字稿。

zh.title: 用户与订单管理总览
zh.summary: 用户管理（用户列表）与订单管理（订单中心）两个模块的入口与手册索引。

zh.title: 查找用户与维护用户信息
zh.summary: 在用户中心按条件查找用户、重发短信验证码、导出用户列表，并使用行内操作（修改信息/添加会员/修改试听课等级）。

en.title: Roles and Permissions Overview
en.summary: The System Configuration page contains the Roles & Permissions, Member Accounts, and Audit Log tabs; it defines the modules and operation levels each role can access, and assigns roles and data scope (business lines) to member accounts.

en.title: Lead Assignment and Auto-Release Rules
en.summary: In Distribution & Auto-Release Settings at the top right of the Sales Center, configure auto-release rules and lead allocation ratios per business line.

en.title: Data Scope and Sensitive Customer Information Protection
en.summary: Configure who can view customer phone numbers and call recordings and who can export data, to meet data compliance requirements in the three countries. (Skeleton page, to be completed.)

en.title: Outreach Channels and Caller ID Number Configuration
en.summary: Manage caller ID number schemes per country and IM channel (Zalo/LINE/WhatsApp) accounts and template applications. (Skeleton page, to be completed.)

en.title: Querying the System Configuration Audit Log
en.summary: In the System Configuration → Audit Log tab, trace who changed which configuration and when by module, operator, and time range.

en.title: Managing Member Accounts and Binding Outbound Calling
en.summary: In the System Configuration → Member Accounts tab, add/edit members, assign roles and business lines, enable or disable accounts, and bind outbound calling for agents.

en.title: View the Dashboard and Conversion Funnel
en.summary: View the six-stage conversion funnel, sales follow-up, and payment results for the same registration cohort by business line.

en.title: Marketing Center Setup Overview
en.summary: The five-step Marketing Center setup chain: Channel → SKU → Channel SKU association → Landing Page → Skin, supporting attribution and selling.

en.title: Add and Maintain Channels
en.summary: Maintain channel types for business lines first, then create specific Sales, KOL, Meta, Google and other channels; channel codes are system-generated.

en.title: Query Sellable SKUs
en.summary: SKUs are maintained centrally by the product system; the Marketing Center is only used to query and select existing products.

en.title: Configure Channel SKU Associations and Selling Prices
en.summary: Each channel maintains one set of association rules; view selling rules and payable amounts for each SKU in one row, with discount or instant-reduction options.

en.title: Create Landing Pages and Get Campaign Links
en.summary: Choose the page type first: acquisition landing pages link only to a channel; payment landing pages additionally link to SKUs, with an optional promo.

en.title: Configure Landing Page Skins
en.summary: Configure landing page skins per business line; only after submission are they published and a template ID generated for selection in Landing Page Management.

en.title: Query Orders and Export the Order List
en.summary: Query orders in the Order Center by order ID / user / product / promo code, verify order status and payment method, and export when needed.

en.title: Sales Center Overview and Lead Flow Rules
en.summary: The Sales Center includes four tabs: Lead Pool, My Follow-ups, Paid, and Call Records; leads flow through a fixed process, with assignment and auto-release settings exclusive to team leads.

en.title: How to Claim a New Lead
en.summary: Claim a lead pending follow-up from the Lead Pool tab in the Sales Center.

en.title: How to Make an Outbound Call and Log a Call Summary
en.summary: Click Dial in the Sales Center to start an outbound call, then complete and save the call summary after hanging up; first-time users must finish phone bar setup.

en.title: How to Record a Follow-up
en.summary: Use the in-row More → Update follow-up in My Follow-ups to log customer feedback, next actions, and callback time in the CRM.

en.title: How to Reassign a Lead or Return It to the Lead Pool
en.summary: Sales leads can hand over leads via More → Reassign lead in My Follow-ups; returning a lead to the Lead Pool requires a reason.

en.title: How to View Call Records and Recordings
en.summary: Review outbound call records by customer or call outcome in the Call Records tab of the Sales Center, with playback of recordings and transcript download.

en.title: Users and Orders Management Overview
en.summary: Entry points and manual index for the two modules: user management (User List) and order management (Order Center).

en.title: Find Users and Maintain User Information
en.summary: Find users by criteria in the User Center, resend SMS verification codes, export the user list, and use row actions (edit information / add membership / edit trial lesson level).
